During the hearing of this petition on 25.1.2022, the representative of the Petitioner, clarified that no additional capital expenditure has been claimed during the period 2019-24, as the Petitioner is to undertake Renovation and Modernization (R&M), as the entire plant had submerged. It was also submitted that the Petitioner will file a fresh petition for approval of R&M as and when the final approval of CEA on the DPR is received. It is noticed that the Petitioner has filed Petition No. 189/MP/2022, before this Commission, on 24.6.2022, seeking approval of R&M, for life extension beyond the normal useful life of the generating station. The said petition was heard on 22.2.2023 and is pending consideration of the Commission.
